_readme: Single source of truth for admin navigation. status: built = exists today, move it; partial = exists but the design adds something; new = not built, log in BACKLOG.md. 'current' is today's route or component; 'route' is the proposed route. Verify every 'current' against src/App.jsx before relying on it. For staff in a client workspace, prefix client routes with /admin/clients/:clientId (see INFORMATION_ARCHITECTURE.md §4).
